name: Ask a Telegram bot to size and preview prospects in Argorant

parameters.content:
## Ask a Telegram bot to size and preview prospects in Argorant

### How it works
Prospect research from your pocket. Every Telegram message to your bot reaches an AI agent that runs on your own chat model and remembers the conversation per chat. It has four Argorant tools: count, a short masked preview, save as list and credits left. It answers with numbers and a few sample titles and companies, and saves a list on request so you can open it in Argorant later. The agent has no tool that spends credits, sends email or launches a campaign.

Argorant actions here are free. Your model provider bills its own usage.

### Setup
1. Install the community node **n8n-nodes-argorant** (tested with 0.3.0 on n8n 2.46.6): Settings > Community nodes > Install. Guide: https://github.com/argorant/n8n-nodes-argorant
2. Add an **Argorant API** credential with a key from Argorant (Settings, API keys).
3. Create a Telegram bot (BotFather), then add a Telegram credential to **Telegram message** and **Answer in Telegram**.
4. Pick a chat model in **Chat model** (any chat model node works).
5. Activate, then message your bot. Limit who may use it with the Chat IDs option of the trigger.

### Customization
Add the Company tools (count, search) for account research.

## Your AI model
Any chat model node works. Memory is kept per Telegram chat.

## Argorant tools
Free tools only: count, preview, save list, credits.

options.systemMessage: You help a sales team find prospects in Argorant. Turn the request into filters (job titles, industry in plain words, countries, states, cities, keywords). Call Count leads first, then Preview leads for a short sample. Save a list only when the user asks for it. Never invent people or numbers. Answer in at most six short lines. You cannot send emails or launch campaigns.
